summary: A manager stresses the cut is company-wide and not about the worker's performance, and it sounds canned.
realLife: Employees describe being told the decision is not about their performance and is part of a company-wide plan; many hear this as a script with no real feedback.
sources: Welcome to the Jungle, frustrating phrases from layoff meetings: https://www.welcometothejungle.com/en/articles/frustrating-phrases-from-layoff-meetings
inGame: the job-ended event can store 'cut for budget' as the reason; a friend or relative's job-lost call can pass it on; needs: feedback on past work

turns.summary: The manager gives a specific example of the person's good work.
pulledBy: a manager who knows the worker
turns.writesBack: a warm last memory; a kept reference promise

turns.summary: The worker accepts it and thanks the manager for saying so.
turns.writesBack: no grudge; a quiet journal note

turns.summary: The worker doubts it because of a recent dispute.
pulledBy: a recent conflict with the boss
turns.writesBack: a grudge and a retelling to friends
